display_name: Pipi Labu Apple and Serving-Prop Kit v1
purpose: An authored Ruby/Honeygold apple and serving-prop family that strengthens hand visibility, contact readability, and customer receipt without changing the current service loop.

design_contract.audience: Roblox players reading one physical apple service beat on desktop, console, and mobile.
design_contract.emotional_register: Warm Japanese-market craft, tactile wood and fruit, generous and playful without toy-menu noise.
accepted_state_to_preserve: Ruby is the ordinary baseline and Honeygold is the single current color contrast.
The held apple remains visible in the player hand and the customer visibly holds the received apple.
The HUD supports the world; the prop, contact, motion, sound, and customer reaction own the sensory reward.
Existing v4 character face/material/PBR direction and Paw_R-centered handoff remain source truth.
design_contract.focal_event: Serving contact and the first held-by-customer beat are larger and clearer than pickup; pickup remains quiet and functional.
design_contract.proof: Exact stud bounds, pivots, collision flags, material roles, contact timing references, authored OBJ/MTL meshes, and a rendered review board.

accepted: Apple as the highest-salience social prop at receipt.
Warm wood, cream, vermilion, and honey-gold hierarchy from the approved HUD and market direction.
Existing 1.3-stud apple scale and paired-paw contact target from read-only gameplay source.
Grounded crate/tray surfaces that frame the handoff without entering the service sightline.
contextual: Japanese market/farmers-market craft cues expressed through slats, shallow trays, restrained markers, and material rhythm.
A small contact accent in the review board as visual explanation only, not a runtime VFX or reward mechanic.
Future rarity seam reserved as a controlled material slot, omitted from the baseline render.
rejected: Pickup spectacle that competes with serving contact.
Glow, particles, floating labels, rarity clutter, or new order/patience/reward mechanics.
Opaque collision on apples, stems, leaves, tray lips, markers, or display fruit.
Pasted HUD/video pixels, logos, social UI, generic asset-store crate decoration, or unbounded prop sprawl.

existing_prop_contract.paired_customer_contact: midpoint of Paw_R and Paw_L when both are present

source_truth.reuse_rule: Read-only source context only. Do not edit or overwrite AppleCatalog, GameService, the local shop builder, or any existing candidate in this ticket.

coordinate_contract.mesh_origin_rule: Do not bake placement into module meshes; pivots are explicit and assembly placement lives in assembly_layout.json.
coordinate_contract.hand_visibility_rule: At authored mobile review distance, the apple body must remain separated from the player/customer paw silhouettes and never hide the paw target.

AppleSkin_Ruby.notes: Glossy enough to read as fruit; no glow or metallic response.

AppleSkin_Honeygold.notes: Single current gold contrast; rarity is not implied.

material_contract.pbr_import_rule: These OBJ/MTL colors are review-grade authored roles. A later Blender/Roblox pass may replace them with named PBR maps, but must preserve the role hierarchy and metalness zero.

modules.handoff_clearance_rule: Keep the front 0.65 studs open so the apple contact path and Paw_R target remain unobstructed.

modules.copy_rule: RUBY is an authored current-state label only; no price, rarity, economy, or prompt behavior is implied.
HONEYGOLD is an authored current-state label only; no price, rarity, economy, or prompt behavior is implied.

collision_contract.rule: Only the structural crate proxy collides. Apples, stems, leaves, tray, marker, and display accents never steal movement, touch, query, or prompts.

handoff.target: Paw_R preferred; midpoint of Paw_R/Paw_L when both exist
handoff.focal_rule: Contact is the largest visual beat; pickup has no special spectacle.

customer_receipt.attachment: CustomerAppleWeld to Paw_R or root fallback
customer_receipt.visible_hold_seconds: existing gameplay celebration/hold contract; no new timing added

rarity_seam.allowed_slot: one thin shoulder material seam or one marker accent band, never both in the same baseline prop
rarity_seam.promotion_rule: A later rarity experiment must be one-variable, visually bounded, and separately gated.

review_artifact.source: deterministic Pillow drawing plus generated OBJ contract labels; no external image pixels
review_artifact.contact_emphasis_rule: The contact frame is the largest, warmest, and clearest state; pickup remains visually quieter.

import_contract.source_format: OBJ + MTL for inspection; Blender 4.x LTS / FBX is the future Roblox import path
import_contract.transforms: Apply scale and rotation in Blender before FBX export; preserve the explicit module pivots and stud dimensions.
import_contract.part_naming: Keep named roots AppleRoot, Stem, Leaf, Tray, CrateFrame, MarkerFace, and CollisionProxy where applicable.
import_contract.surface_appearance: Future Roblox PBR wiring must preserve the material roles and metalness zero; no asset IDs are included here.
import_contract.scripts: No scripts, prompts, ownership, economy, or gameplay authority are embedded in the candidate.

future_private_play_gate.precondition: The v0.9.3 human service-loop gate is recorded or explicitly deferred; ART-003 is not gameplay evidence and does not promote any mechanic.
visual_review: Leo and Jon review the generated board and a mobile-sized thumbnail; Ruby remains the ordinary baseline and Honeygold remains the only current contrast.
Reject if the apple disappears against the hand/customer, the stem/leaf creates a noisy silhouette, the tray/crate blocks Paw_R or the service line, or contact reads weaker than pickup.
Reject any glow, rarity clutter, false price/economy implication, or collision-looking display detail.
future_private_play_gate.sandbox: In a disposable local PlaceId=0 / GameId=0 sandbox, import one apple plus one crate proxy and one tray. Validate pivot, size, material roles, attachment offsets, collision/query flags, and mobile camera read before any private-place test.
bounded_private_test: List Studio instances and assert the exact PlaceId/GameId inside the bounded mutation.
Keep AppleCatalog, GameService, prompts, queue membership, order sequence, patience, rewards, audio, and HUD source unchanged.
Test Ruby and Honeygold through pickup, visible carry, toss, contact, and customer-held receipt at desktop and mobile camera distances; contact/receipt must remain the sensory peak.
Walk through the crate and counter area; confirm only the crate proxy collides and no apple/tray/marker steals a prompt or creates collision ambiguity.
Remove the candidate root if it hides the hand, obscures the ready customer, weakens the contact beat, adds clutter, or makes pickup feel more rewarding than service.
future_private_play_gate.promotion: Only an explicit later Leo/Jon visual decision followed by sandbox and exact-private-place validation may approve the prop family; no upload, publish, canonical replacement, or mechanic is implied.
